rules.logic: (BIOC(ITDR-006 AS-REQ For Pre-Auth-Disabled Account (AS-REP Roast)) OR BIOC(ITDR-006 Kerberos TGS-REQ RC4 Burst For Multiple SPNs)) AND BIOC(ITDR-006 LDAP SPN Sweep From Non-Typical Host) — groups AS-REP Roasting and Kerberoasting harvesting from one source host into a single Credential Access incident.
rules.name: AD Offline-Roasting Credential Harvest From One Source
